# opnsense_captiveportal_zone (Resource)

Captive portal zones (**Services ▸ Captive Portal ▸ Administration**). Interfaces must have a static IPv4 address. Changes are applied by reloading the captive portal and ipfw.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_captiveportal_zone" "guest" {
  interfaces   = ["opt2"]
  description  = "guest wifi"
  auth_servers = ["Local Database"]
  template     = opnsense_captiveportal_template.guest.id
  idle_timeout = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the zone.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces of the zone, e.g. `["opt1"]`.

### Optional

- `allowed_addresses` (Set of String) Addresses or networks that bypass the portal. Defaults to `[]`.
- `allowed_mac_addresses` (Set of String) MAC addresses that bypass the portal. Defaults to `[]`.
- `always_send_accounting_reqs` (Boolean) Send RADIUS accounting requests for every authentication server, not only RADIUS ones. Defaults to `false`.
- `auth_enforce_group` (String) GID of the local group users must belong to, empty for none. Defaults to ``.
- `auth_servers` (Set of String) Authentication servers, e.g. `["Local Database"]`. Empty lets everyone in after clicking through. Defaults to `[]`.
- `certificate` (String) Reference ID of the certificate used to serve the portal over HTTPS, empty for HTTP. Defaults to ``.
- `concurrent_logins` (Boolean) Allow the same user to be logged in from several devices. Defaults to `true`.
- `disable_rules` (Boolean) Do not add the automatic firewall rules for the portal; write them yourself. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the zone is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `extended_pre_auth_data` (Boolean) Make the client IP and MAC available to the login page. Defaults to `false`.
- `hard_timeout` (Number) Minutes after which a client is disconnected regardless of activity, 0 for never. Defaults to `0`.
- `idle_timeout` (Number) Minutes of inactivity before a client is disconnected, 0 for never. Defaults to `0`.
- `roaming` (Boolean) Keep a session when the client changes IP address (same MAC). Defaults to `true`.
- `server_name` (String) Host name the portal redirects to, needed when using a certificate. Defaults to ``.
- `template` (String) UUID of an `opnsense_captiveportal_template`, empty for the default page. Defaults to ``.
- `zone_id` (Number) Zone number (0-19), assigned by OPNsense when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the captive portal zone.
